# 岁知社 IPTrust

岁知社 IPTrust 是一个面向人和 Agent 的 IP 品牌信任中枢。
English: A fast, minimal IP trust hub for brand guidelines, design systems, assets, and agent-readable source files.

Machine-readable entry points:
- /api/manifest.json
- /api/brands.json
- /api/brands/{slug}.json

Brands:
- Table AI (tableai): /api/brands/tableai.json · palette #0A1626 / #A88B52
- VANAHOM (vanahom): /api/brands/vanahom.json · palette #B12137 / #A8ADAD
- KiND (kind): /api/brands/kind.json · palette #0E8C7B / #E8765A
- APHA (apha): /api/brands/apha.json · palette #557F8F / #8FAF83
- MANA Endless (manaendless): /api/brands/manaendless.json · palette #7BC8C4 / #B7A7D8
- OPC Global (opcglobal): /api/brands/opcglobal.json · palette #1D3557 / #B79B63
- IPTrustasset (iptrust): /api/brands/iptrust.json · palette #10263D / #B99B5B
- 峰值永造局 (fengzhi): /api/brands/fengzhi.json · palette #1A1714 / #A47B36
- Axisee (axisee): /api/brands/axisee.json · palette #1A2B4A / #B12137
- Sidera (sidera): /api/brands/sidera.json · palette #B58B4C / #D4A862

Admin workflow:
- /admin.html unlocks with the generated admin key.
- Edits are committed back to GitHub via the GitHub Contents API.
- GitHub Pages rebuilds from main after changes land.
